question: does the portfolio's shape survive its own construction choice (the concurrent cap)?
verdict: THE EDGE IS CAP-ROBUST, DESIGN SAMPLE: every rung of the ladder compounds positively (caps 5: +83.2%, 10: +76.2%, 15: +76.2%, 20: +76.2%) - the headline is not an artifact of the construction choice, and the max drawdown is cap-invariant (0.4312). The constraint NEVER BINDS above 10: caps 10/15/20 are the same book (the market never offers more than 10 concurrent episodes). Cap 5 reads higher (0.8325) because it DROPS trades by entry order - selection by calendar, not by information; an honest curiosity, flagged, never a rule
note: same entries, holds, costs and date grid; the cap is a capacity assumption, not a measured edge - the forward log scores the edge, never the cap; design sample
